articles.title: Mystery Polymarket trader turned $4 million into $9 million after Spain's shocking World Cup draw
articles.snippet: A days-old account turned about $4 million into a $9 million profit betting against Spain, an anomaly trade that onchain sleuths are asking whether it was luck or inside information.

articles.title: Crypto PAC has $12M stake in Senate primary runoff as Alabama voters head to polls
articles.snippet: Defend American Jobs reported spending $7.4 million on media to support Republican Barry Moore ahead of his May 20 Alabama primary, and an additional $4.7 million before Tuesday’s runoffs.

articles.title: Someone Just Lost $1 Million on Polymarket Over Spain World Cup Shocker
articles.snippet: One trader lost $1 million betting Spain would win. Another bought "No" at 9¢ and walked away with $4.3 million.

articles.title: One Indicted Over Crypto ‘Wrench Attack’ in France
articles.snippet: The crypto-related assault reportedly involved attackers posing as police officers, and follows a spate of attacks in the country.
